title: The 5 Best Jump Ropes for Weighted Training
h1: The 5 Best Jump Ropes for Weighted Training
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for jump ropes for weighted training, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at jump ropes for weighted training using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Gaiam Weighted Jump Rope 1-Pound Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 0.5-pound foam handles, 1 pound total, Adjustable up to 9 feet, PVC-covered rope.
strengths: 1-pound total weight is enough to add real shoulder and forearm demand without wrecking rotation speed
Foam grip stays comfortable through longer sets than a hard plastic handle would
Adjustable cable fits a wide range of heights without buying a separate size
limitations: Slower rotation than an unweighted speed rope, so it's not the tool for double-under practice
Handle weight adds fatigue faster than a standard rope over long sessions
PVC rope is less durable long term than coated steel cable

products.name: WOD Nation Speed Jump Rope
products.blurb: Key specs: 2.2mm coated steel cable, 4-bearing handle system, Adjustable up to 10 feet.
strengths: The included thicker cable adds some resistance without going fully weighted, a useful middle step
Fast rotation makes it the natural complement to a weighted rope for cardio-focused sessions
Durable enough to handle daily alternating use alongside a weighted rope
limitations: Not actually a weighted rope, so it doesn't replace the strength benefit of the Gaiam set
Thin steel cable feels like a big jump in speed right after using a weighted rope
Bearing screws need occasional re-tightening with heavy rotation

products.name: Crossrope Get Strong Weighted Jump Rope Set
limitations: Heavy ropes are slow for footwork

products.name: EliteSRS Muay Thai 2.0 Heavy Jump Rope
strengths: Heavy rope builds shoulders and endurance
Good for boxing and MMA conditioning

products.name: Elite Jumps Heavy Beaded Jump Rope
limitations: Beads hurt if they hit you

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
